'''Hugo Eckener''' was a [[Chief Architect/Legends|Chief Architect]] serving the [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council/Legends|Naboo Royal Advisory Council]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Eckener was tasked with protecting Naboo's art and history, while continuing the civic expansion.

==Biography==
[[File:HugoEckener.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Hugo Eckener in the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]] sometime after [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].]]
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] Hugo Eckener was part of the reelected members of the [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council/Legends|Naboo Royal Advisory Council]], headed by [[Sio Bibble/Legends|Sio Bibble]]. Like all other members, Eckener maintained a good relationship with the other representatives of the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] government.

As Chief Architect of Naboo, Eckener was greatly appreciated. The Naboo appreciated art and [[Architect/Legends|architecture]] and found the architecture of their [[City/Legends|citiese]] and buildings very important. Before stepping into politics, Eckener was already an established architect. Along with architecture, Eckener represented all professions having to do with Naboo's infrastructure, such as construction workers, traders and contractors. Eckener was also responsible for new construction projects in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. He had to take into account that these new buildings would fit perfectly into the urban landscape, without standing out.

As a member of the Royal Advisory Council, Eckener worked hard for better [[Flight group/Legends|flights]], roads and communication between the different sites on Naboo, where he also managed. In 32 BBY the planet fell into hard times with the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] and [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Eckener was in the Theed throne room when communication with then-[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was disrupted. While going to ask [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] for help on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Eckener, along with the people of Theed, were captured and put in the Trade Federation's prisoner of war camps. When the Trade Federation was defeated, Eckener regained his position as Chief Architect of Naboo.

By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Hugo Eckener had eventually retired from his position.<ref name="SWG:TCG:POGG">[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], his son [[Karl Eckener|Karl]] ran up huge gambling debts to both the [[Skaak Tippers]] and the [[Darkwalkers|Darkwalker]] criminal groups. Karl Eckener was finally kidnapped and Hugo was forced to pay his son's debts off by sustaining spacers working for them.<ref name="SWG:EHB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Everyone Hates Borvo|Naboo}}</ref> Skaak Tipper [[Toff Henrou]] and Darkwalker [[Jorgellansel]] blackmailed Eckener to make him attack each other.<ref name="SWG:DSTDW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Doing Skaak Tipper Dirty Work" on Naboo</ref><ref name="SWG:DDD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Doing Darkwalker Deeds" on Naboo</ref> Nevertheless, Karl Eckener was never freed by the criminals. Hugo Eckener was forced to request [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|RSF]] agents to [[Rescue of Karl Eckener|liberate]] his son by force.<ref name="SWG:RKE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The character shares his name with [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hugo_Eckener Hugo Eckener], a commander of the ''Graf Zeppelin'' and starch opponent to the Nazi regime.
